paragraphs.text: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: CodeMirror Markdown composer with paste-URL-as-link, plus brand-icon
link rendering in sent user messages
# dsh-link-plugin

One small DSH browser plugin for links: **paste a URL over selected composer
text** and **render Mar
kdown links in sent user messages**.

Rebuilt 2026-10-24 (version 0.3.0) as a link-only plugin after the previous
version — a 50k-line for

k of the `dsh-markdown-input` composer takeover — was
disabled by DSH's compatibility check when the

app upgraded from `0.2.1-rc.2`
to `0.2.1-rc.3` (it pinned `engines.dsh: "0.2.1-rc.2"` exactly, so t

he whole
bundle was skipped at startup). The takeover composer is gone; the two link
features are no
w built only on DSH's documented extension surfaces.
## What it does

1. **Paste a URL over selected text** — select `repo` in the DSH composer,
press `Cmd/Ctrl+V` with `

https://github.com/…` on the clipboard: the
selection becomes `repo` as one undoable edit.
Plain tex

t, non-URL pastes, image/file pastes, and pastes outside the
composer are untouched. If the host ref

uses the edit, the native paste
happens instead (nothing is swallowed).
2. **Links in sent user mess

ages** — a user message containing
`repo` renders the link as a small site icon plus
an underlined `

repo` label (GitHub, npm, GitLab, YouTube, X, Figma,
Notion, Bilibili, Zhihu, Wikipedia, LinkedIn, G

oogle, Reddit, Discord,
Telegram, WeChat, Stack Overflow, Medium, Hugging Face, Substack — other
hos

ts get a generic link glyph). In a sent bubble it is a normal external
anchor; queue previews show a

static span. Model input and copy/clipboard
keep the Markdown source.
## Why it should survive DSH upgrades

The old breakage was structural, not a bug in one line. The new design removes
the coupling that mad
e every host update a porting project:
| Risk in the previous build | What this build does instead |
| Exact `engines.dsh` pin → DSH's compatibility preflight **skips the whole bundle** on any version
change | No `engines.dsh` and no `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer dependencies at all. The preflight can nev

er disable it; the plugin loads and checks at runtime. |
| 1.9 MB fork of the host composer (CodeMir
ror takeover + host React primitives) | 43 KB hand-written bundle, **no `require()` of host client p

ackages**; React from the browser seed table is the only import. |
| Leaning on host components (`Li
nkIconMedium`, `UserTextRun`) that change without notice | Own inline SVG icons and markup; styling

uses theme tokens / `currentColor`, so a renamed token only changes appearance. |
| One import error
killed every feature and could blank the composer | Two features register independently and are eac
h guarded; a missing service or slot disables that feature only and prints a clear `[dsh-link-plugin
missing service or slot disables that feature only and prints a clear `[dsh-link-plugin]` warning. |

Only these documented host surfaces are used (all verified against DSH
`0.2.1-rc.3`):

- `conversation.input.overlay` list slot (composer) + its standard
provide-channel props `useInput`

er()` rule registry;
- `conversation.user.text.node` keyed slot.

If DSH ever renames one of them, `tools/compat-check.mjs` says which one, the
plugin keeps working f

or everything else, and the fix is one small guarded
registration in `lib/client.js` — not a rebase

and the fix is one small guarded
registration in `lib/client.js` — not a rebase of a 50k-line fork.
## Target / compatibility

- Built and tested against **DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`** (macOS desktop). The plugin
declares no upper versio

n bound by design; drift is detected, not assumed.
- Runs on the native DSH composer. There is inten

tionally **no live
Markdown-rendering composer takeover** in this version.
- User messages render *i

nline links* only — other Markdown (`**bold**`,
headings, code blocks) stays plain text in user bubb

les.
- Composer links are not clickable while editing; sent-bubble links open in a
new window.

(`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle` with

the absolute directory) — that path
handles the package and profile copy for you.

> **Replacing an existing install:** the profile keeps its own copy of the
> package under `node_mod

ules/`. pnpm can consider an unchanged `file:` spec
> "already up to date" and leave that stale copy

in place, so after
> editing/replacing the plugin directory use the precise refresh:
>

> A stale copy keeps loading old JavaScript and is exactly what
> `tools/compat-check.mjs` flags.
## Verification
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`tools/compat-check.mjs` reads the installed DSH app (default
`/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app`,

override `--app` / `DSH_APP`, or
`--host-modules <dir>` for npm installs) and checks:

- the DSH runtime version and the plugin manifest (an exact version pin is a
hard FAIL — that is the

failure mode this rewrite removes);
- the host client surfaces above, searched in the installed con

ges;
- whether the profile's installed copy is stale compared with the repo.

Exit code 0 = PASS (or PASS with warnings), 1 = FAIL with the exact missing
surface. Run it right af

ter a DSH update; it is the “did the host move under
us?” alarm.

The real end-to-end check (paste + Enter + sent-bubble render on DSH
`0.2.1-rc.3`) was run on 2026-1

0-24 in an isolated `dsh web` instance with
headless Chrome over the Chrome DevTools Protocol: **15/

15 assertions passed**
(plugin row in the boot graph, no compatibility-skip line, clean console,
pas

te-to-link in the composer, brand-icon link in the sent bubble, generic
icon for unknown hosts, nati
ve fallback for non-URL pastes). Screenshots:

Re-run the same flow after a host update if `compat-check` reports a warning;
the harness and its in

structions live in `tests/e2e/README.md`.
It is developer tooling only and is not shipped inside the

in `tests/e2e/README.md`.
It is developer tooling only and is not shipped inside the plugin package.
## Upgrade procedure after a DSH update（中文）

1. 更新 DSH 后运行 `node tools/compat-check.mjs`。
2. **PASS** → 插件继续工作（不会再因为版本号被 DSH 直接禁用）。
